channel.title: Audio :: Kwik5 Doc
channel.description: Audio Play Pause Resume Rewind Stop Set Volume Mute/Unmute Read to Me Play Read to Me Play Sync Record Audio

item.title: Play Audio
item.description: Play Audio play the selected audio from the list. Controls is added in Kwik4

item.title: Pause Audio
item.description: Pause Audio pause the selected audio from the list.

item.title: Resume Audio
item.description: Resume Audio resume the selected audio from the list.

item.title: Rewind Audio
item.description: Rewind Audio rewind the selected audio from the list.

item.title: Stop Audio
item.description: Stop Audio stop the selected audio from the list.

item.title: Set Volume
item.description: Set Volume set the channel volume of the selected audio from the list.

item.title: Mute on/Off
item.description: Mute On/Off mute/unmute all audio channels;

item.title: Read To Me
item.description: Read To Me this action activate or deactivate the ability to “read to me” (when enabled, it will play the narration audio for the page) and go to the page. Parameters are: Enable Read to Me: when enabled plays the narration audio of each page Go to NEXT page automatically: starts the first transition immediately, going to the next page.

item.title: Play Read To Me
item.description: Play Read To Me this action plays the audio narration file of the page. This is different to “Read to Me” action that opens the page.

item.title: Play Sync
item.description: Play Sync play a synced text/audio layer

item.title: Record Audio
item.description: Record Audio allows the recording of an audio file for the current page. Parameters are: Duration: the amount of time the audio will be recorded; Dim screen while recording: amount, in percentage, of screen-dimming to visually provide feedback that the audio is recording. You can use external codes for better handling recording audio. Please check Advanced Recording
